content: {"reasoning":"The notice on the table is CO-29 (timely filing expired), but the first submission occurred ~149 days after service (69 days ago), which was within the 180-day window—so the timely-filing denial is contestable via proof of original timely submission. None of the listed actions fit this: appeal_with_necessity argues medical necessity (wrong grounds for a timely-filing denial), resubmission would trigger CO-29/CO-18, and retro-auth isn't offered (auth isn't even required). Since no available action properly advances a timely-filing rebuttal, this touch requires a human specialist.","action":"escalate"}
